title: LA Colossal – Minakari 04 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Iranian woman in her mid-50s, silver-streaked dark hair in a low bun with a small gold comb, natural face with a dignified smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the divan, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Persian minakari enamel body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, no collar band. Glossy turquoise and cobalt enamel base with fine gold outlines, filled with lotus, tulips, and peacocks. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated upright on a low tiled divan, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Towering 9-inch cobalt enamel peep-toe platform stilettos with a single gold ankle strap.
Nails: Extra long oval nails, cobalt with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: Shiraz garden pavilion with stained glass casting colored light, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm key with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
